name: SGLang-Diffusion
description: SGLang's diffusion serving path: the same runtime and scheduler as its text serving, behind an OpenAI-shaped images API, with online FP8 and loaders for GGUF and NVFP4 components. Separate from `sglang` for the same reason vllm-omni is separate from vllm — different endpoints, different model support, different numbers.

serve.notes: The launcher of the diffusion path may differ from the text one; take the command from the installed build's documentation and record what was actually run.

notes: Takes guidance_scale where vLLM-Omni takes true_cfg_scale. Guidance above 1 runs a second transformer forward per denoising step, so two lanes whose defaults differ are doing different amounts of work — record the effective value in args before comparing seconds per image. versions_available is empty on purpose. A version file has to carry that build's real flags and their real defaults (AGENTS.md), and a wrong default silently merges two configurations into one fingerprint. Nobody has installed this engine for this model yet, so the first run that does reads `--help` on the actual build and adds the version file in the same pull request as its numbers.
